QUOTE: They are copied into `PermissionManager` when `ServerManager` is constructed (`server_manager.cpp:32–36`, called from `facade/entropic.cpp:792`). Later config edits do not affect it.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the lists are copied into PermissionManager when ServerManager is constructed, parsed from the config's `permissions` section. It never names PermissionsConfig as the object ServerManager is constructed with.
